headline: the supply story is *almost over*.

panes.title: EVERY KAS THAT WILL EVER EXIST
panes.sub: one dot is 1% of the maximum

post.x: 96.85% of every KAS that will ever exist is already mined. 904,774,633 KAS are still to come, and 99% is reached in june 2028 at the current schedule. what comes after keeps halving every twelve months.
post.reply: the full emission schedule is on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. the remaining amount shrinks and never quite reaches the maximum.
